title: A second line
description: A second label rolls into view as you approach the action.
useCase: Pair a short expressive call to action with a concrete label on an occasional marketing action.
interaction: Hover, then join the reading list
reducedMotion: The first label stays in place; the button still updates its subscribed state.
limitations: Hover text is a fine-pointer enhancement. The accessible action label remains clear on touch and keyboard.
look: Warm greige page with one wide dark olive-green rounded button holding a single line of white sans-serif text.
motion: On fine-pointer hover the label track slides up 100% (300 ms ease-in-out) inside the clipped button, fading the first label out as a second label below fades in.
adapt: The rollover is pure CSS: hover moves `.sf-slide-track` to `translateY(-100%)` over 300 ms `cubic-bezier(.645,.045,.355,1)` while the two `.sf-slide-face` layers swap opacity, gated by `(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine)`. Replace `text`, `hoverText` and the `subscribed` toggle.
